newsitem.title: USA: Tracor declares prfd shr purchase rights.
newsitem.headline: Tracor declares prfd shr purchase rights.

text.p: Tracor Inc said Tuesday that its board has declared a dividend distribution of one preferred share purchase right for each of its common shares.
The dividend distribution, which is non-taxable to stockholders, will be made February 17 to holders of record on that date and will expire February 17, 2007, the company said.
Each right entitles stockholders to buy one one-hundredth of a share of a new series of junior participating preferred stock at an exercise price of $100.
The company said the rights are exercisable if a person or group acquires 20 percent or more of its common stock or announces a tender offer that would have the same effect.
The rights are meant to give its shareholders "fair and equal treatment in the event of any proposed takeover," the company said in a release.
